title.en: sunrise at the foz, clear sky.
title.de: sonnenaufgang an der foz, klarer himmel.

line.en: clear and dry on thursday; sunrise about 07:10. be at passeio alegre by 06:45 and wait by the river.
line.de: klar und trocken am donnerstag; sonnenaufgang gegen 07:10. um 06:45 am passeio alegre sein und am fluss warten.
line.tr: perşembe günü açık ve kuru; gün doğumu yaklaşık 07:10. saat 06:45'te passeio alegre'de olun ve nehir kenarında bekleyin.

sparks.why: IPMA forecast quoted by Viva Porto: sun and clear sky on Thu 5 Nov; sunrise about 07:05 on 1 Nov per sunrise-sunset.org, so about 07:10 by the 5th.
